question:
Kindly evaluate and give your comments





Most of the people in society enjoy watching crime movies and criminal TV programs. Why do you think people have more interest to watch them? What is the impact on the society due to this?



Movies and television shows that are related to crime have become increasingly popular these days. The reason I think people like to watch them is either out of curiosity or for the adrenaline rush that these shows provide. Overall, these entertainment programs have more positive effect among viewers as they help in creating more awareness.



Some of these shows are actually inspired by real life events or based on them. People who have heard the stories want to know the details and hence, switch to these shows to satisfy their curiosity. For instance, few years back a murder case of Watt’s family was all over the news which happened in a small town in Colorado. Many shows and documentaries were made based on this event because people wanted to know what actually happened and the motive behind the homicide of the family. Additionally, for some the major reason for tuning is the thrill that is provided by these shows. Interesting plotlines and grey characters hook movie goers to the screen. Thus, for these reasons, crime movies have become the top choice for some people.



Crimes related television not only provides the entertainment value but awaresness is created as well. Because of them people come to know about the impact crimes have on individuals and families. Many questions such as how the lives of the victims and criminals turned upside down and what were the punishments received by the criminals are answered by watching them. Many people sympathize with the victims when they come to know about the real motives behind the crimes and therefore develop a strong sense of judgement and fair trials.



In conclusion, people like to watch these shows because they provide entertainment. They also get knowledge about different crimes and its outcome within the community and families.
